solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Decorator's coat is long past being mended

indicators.note: something being mended is being reworked and put back together, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: ten letters taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A painter complains that their coat is far too worn to be repaired.
explanation.walkthrough: The decorator's coat looks like a jacket beyond repair; it is the layer of paint a decorator applies.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiny enamel finish is a typical top layer a house painter brushes onto woodwork, hence a coat in the trade sense.

clue.text: Kind of shop officers ran

parts.note: generals are senior army officers
to tear along is to run fast

explanation.surface: A shop that was managed by a group of officers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ran' suggests managing the shop, but it means rushed, as in tearing down the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A village outlet selling a wide range of everyday goods is one particular variety of retail business.

clue.text: Bottomless vessel full of American food

indicators.note: without a bottom means the final letter, the bottom of a down entry, is removed
a thing full of something has it inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a ship is a vessel, cut short here
US is the abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: A broken pot overflowing with American cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a pot or bowl, but it is a ship; dropping its last letter leaves room for the American abbreviation inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese dish of vinegared rice with raw fish is one example of something to eat.

clue.text: Through prayer, God provides abundance

indicators.note: one thing running through another passes inside it, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a plea is an earnest request, a prayer
Thor is the Norse god of thunder

explanation.surface: A pious claim that praying brings plenty from heaven.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a religious sentiment; 'Through' tells you the god goes through the prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe an excess or great quantity of something, so they are near synonyms.

clue.text: Moving, deep and nice end to Yankee anniversary

indicators.note: things that are moving shift position, so these letters are set in a new order

parts.note: fourteen letters taken as written for rearranging

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, so only that letter is kept

parts.note: the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A touching, profound and pleasant conclusion to an American celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moving' reads as emotionally touching, but it signals the rearrangement; 'Yankee' supplies only its last letter while also hinting at the American theme.
explanation.definitionFit: The Fourth of July marks the yearly commemoration of the 1776 declaration, so it is an annual remembrance date.

clue.text: Times article about a rare material

indicators.note: to be about something is to surround it, so one piece is placed around another

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time, and times makes two of them
taken as written
R is an abbreviation for rare, as in grading coins
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about an unusual fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper, but it is two copies of T for time, which then wrap around the next two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Checked woollen cloth associated with Scottish clans is a kind of fabric, which is what material means here.

clue.text: Beginnings of love ought to stop grim poet's misery

indicators.note: a stopper plugs a gap, so these letters are put inside another word to block it

parts.note: dour means stern or gloomy

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, so only the opening letters are kept

parts.note: the first letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Love should end a gloomy poet's suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stop' sounds like ending the misery, but it means plugging a gap, with the first letters plugged into the word for gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: The word for sorrow or grief is literary and old-fashioned, the kind of term found mostly in verse.

clue.text: Dress up and show off

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means reading from bottom to top, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: garb is clothing, a way of dressing

explanation.surface: Put on fine clothes and parade yourself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dress up' reads as one phrase meaning put on finery, but 'up' is separate and turns the clothing word upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Boasting loudly about yourself is a way of flaunting, so the verbs are close synonyms.

clue.text: On notice to adopt wild animals

indicators.note: adopting someone takes them into your home, so one piece is taken inside another

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
boar, wild pigs, is its own plural

explanation.surface: A notice posted asking people to take in wild animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' is the definition, in the sense of being on a ship or train; boar serves as the plural for several wild pigs.
explanation.definitionFit: Being aboard a vessel or vehicle means being on it, so in that travel sense the words match.

clue.text: Broadcaster's novel dares rubbish the Queen

parts.note: novel means new

indicators.note: to rubbish something is to trash it, so these letters are knocked into a new order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the late Queen's cipher

explanation.surface: A broadcaster's novel boldly criticises the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like a book written by the broadcaster, but it is the adjective meaning fresh; 'rubbish' is a verb meaning trash.
explanation.definitionFit: A presenter who reads out the bulletins on radio or television is one kind of broadcaster.

clue.text: Idea that's not finished yet

indicators.note: something not finished lacks its ending, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a thought is an idea, here missing its final letter

explanation.surface: A half-formed notion that has not been completed so far.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yet' looks like part of 'not finished yet', meaning so far, but it is the definition in its sense of nevertheless.
explanation.definitionFit: As conjunctions or adverbs both mean however or nevertheless, introducing a contrast, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Frank trailing in last part of the race

indicators.note: something trailing follows behind, so this piece comes after the other

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
frank means honest or straight

explanation.surface: A runner named Frank is lagging behind near the end of a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like a runner's name, but it means candid; 'in' gives the word for being at home.
explanation.definitionFit: The final stretch of track leading to the finishing line is the closing section of a race.

clue.text: Root of resistance to a recipe

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance
the article, with 'to' joining it on
a dish is something prepared from a recipe

explanation.surface: The source of someone's dislike of a particular recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Root of resistance' reads as the cause of an objection; it is the definition plus the physics symbol R.
explanation.definitionFit: The crunchy red salad vegetable is the edible taproot of its plant, so it is an example.

clue.text: Thief finally confronted over coffee

indicators.note: turning something over flips it, so the letters are read backwards
finally points to the last of something, so only the final letter is kept

parts.note: the final letter of the word
to confront someone is to face them

explanation.surface: A burglar is finally challenged over a cup of coffee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over' looks like 'about' or 'during', but it reverses everything before it.
explanation.definitionFit: Decaf, often spelt with two Fs in Britain, is a caffeine-free brew, so it is a type of coffee.

clue.text: Old American tanks housing university fish collection

indicators.note: housing something means giving it a home inside, so one piece sits within another
to tank is to collapse or fail, so these letters fall apart and regroup

parts.note: O is a standard abbreviation for old
taken as written for rearranging
U is the abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: Old American fish tanks are home to a university's specimen collection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tanks' fits the fish surface as aquariums, but it is a verb meaning collapses, signalling the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A large saltwater aquarium displaying marine life is a public exhibit gathering many sea creatures.

clue.text: Complex mix of simple forces

indicators.note: a complex mix jumbles its ingredients, so these letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A physics paradox: a complicated combination of basic forces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forces' looks like a physics noun, but it is a verb, as in drives someone to act.
explanation.definitionFit: To urge or drive someone into action is to compel them, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Standard heroes possess grit alongside guts

indicators.note: placed alongside means set next to, so the pieces join end to end
to possess is to hold, so one piece is held inside another

parts.note: stars are celebrated heroes
sand is grit
tripes is an old word for entrails

explanation.surface: Typical heroes show courage as well as nerve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standard' looks like an adjective meaning typical, but it is a flag; 'grit' and 'guts' look like courage but are sand and entrails.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a flag or banner, and the American national flag is a well-known example.

clue.text: High priest, maybe, that keeps rejoicers oddly suppressed

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold on to it, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: with the odd-numbered letters held down out of sight, only the even ones remain

parts.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters

explanation.surface: A senior cleric who keeps celebrating worshippers in check.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' usually keeps the odd letters; here they are suppressed, so the even ones survive.
explanation.definitionFit: A theocrat rules by religious authority, and a high priest wielding civil power is an example, hence 'maybe'.

clue.text: Drink trader left in charge of pound stores

indicators.note: to store things is to keep them inside, so one piece is held within another

parts.note: taken as written
a pound is an enclosure, bounded by a fence
L is the abbreviation for left
IC is the abbreviation for in charge

explanation.surface: A wine merchant left in charge of a store's money.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain an off-licence is a shop licensed to sell alcohol to take away. The equation of a pound with a fence is loose: a pound is the enclosed area.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop selling beer, wine and spirits for consumption elsewhere is a retailer of alcoholic beverages.

clue.text: How to sound lower class

indicators.note: asking how a word sounds points to its pronunciation, so a word spoken the same is wanted

parts.note: to lessen is to lower or reduce

explanation.surface: Advice on how to speak with a working-class accent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lower class' looks like a social phrase, but 'lower' is a verb and 'class' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A period of teaching given to pupils at school is a class, so the nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Publication about someone originally from space

indicators.note: to be about something is to go around it, so one piece encloses another

parts.note: a comic is a publication

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so only the opening letter is kept

parts.note: the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A magazine story about an alien visitor from outer space.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Someone originally from space' reads as an alien, but 'originally' takes just the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things relating to or coming from the universe beyond Earth, such as cosmic rays.

clue.text: Port passed, offering bottles to the left

indicators.note: in an across clue moving to the left means reading backwards
a bottle holds its contents inside, so the letters are held within these words

parts.note: letters spanning the two words

explanation.surface: At dinner the port is passed to the left, as etiquette demands.
explanation.walkthrough: Port is passed to the left at formal dinners, so the surface is a real custom; here 'Port' is a harbour city.
explanation.definitionFit: Odessa is a major Black Sea harbour city in Ukraine, so it is an example of a seaport.

clue.text: Praise almost imparted by husband once

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped
by means beside, so the pieces are set next to each other

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
told means imparted, cut short

explanation.surface: Compliments nearly passed on by a former husband.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Once' attaches to 'husband' to give the former partner, not to the praise.
explanation.definitionFit: To laud or speak highly of someone is to commend them enthusiastically, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Is prejudiced leader replaced at last?

indicators.note: the front letter is put back at the end, so the word rotates by one place

parts.note: sexist means prejudiced against one sex

explanation.surface: A question: has a biased boss finally been removed?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is' looks like the start of a question but is the definition, in the sense of being real.
explanation.definitionFit: To be, in the sense of having being or reality, is the same as to have existence.

clue.text: Period celebrated by mother and son

parts.note: x reads as by in measurements such as six by four
ma is mother
S is the abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A holiday season enjoyed by a mother and her son.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By' looks like a link to the celebrators, but it gives X, the multiplication sign read as 'by'.
explanation.definitionFit: The festive season around 25 December is a time of year when people hold festivities.

clue.text: Fashion classification becoming less extreme

parts.note: mode means fashion
a rating is a grade or classification

explanation.surface: Clothing categories are growing milder.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the whole closing phrase, a participle, matching the -ING form of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To moderate is to grow calmer or more restrained, so the participle means softening toward the middle.

clue.text: Enlightenment leads to turning out in Eastern dress

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another

parts.note: a sari is a South Asian wrapped garment

indicators.note: the leading letters of words are their first ones, so only those are kept

parts.note: the first letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Spiritual awakening comes from appearing in oriental clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leads to' reads as 'results in', but it takes the leading letters of the next two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Satori is the Zen Buddhist term for sudden spiritual awakening, matching the religious sense of the word.

clue.text: Sort of rock song collection put together for radio

indicators.note: putting things together joins them, so the pieces are placed side by side

parts.note: quartz crystal is a type of rock
a set is the list of songs a band plays at a gig

explanation.surface: Assembling a rock music compilation to be played on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' and 'song collection' suggest rock music, but the rock is a mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: An early simple wireless receiver using a mineral detector is an old-fashioned type of radio.
